About

Clan Wars October 2025 is a tournament organised by the OFM.

As the third edition of the Clan Wars, the event features the biggest clans of Openfront.

Format

General

  • Game Mode: Teams
  • Players per Team: Minimum 4 players, maximum 6 players, + 2 substitutes
  • Date: October 5th 2025
  • Map Rotation: The following 6 maps were played in this exact rotation:
    • Gateway to the Atlantic
    • Montreal
    • Australia
    • Africa
    • Iceland
    • Between Two Seas
  • Scoring System:
    • First clan to win two games is declared the winner.

Rules

  • Teaming allowed
  • No collusion
  • No toxicity
  • No spawn killing
  • No MIRVs
